title: Fokker-Planck analysis and invariant laws for a continuous-time stochastic model inspired by Adam
summary: We study a degenerate stochastic system inspired by bias-corrected Adam. The system arises as the continuous-time limit of an explicitly modified recursion in which the squared-gradient update is replaced by a prescribed second-moment closure. We construct an entrance solution at the singular initial time and prove convergence of the modified recursion on finite time intervals away from zero.
